stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Kowalik Returns for Series 2, Leads Individual Race

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Kayla Kowalik is back. After missing Series 1, she returned as a Series 2 captain in the 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup — and Team Kowalik went unbeaten through Series 2. Kowalik is now the individual points leader. The defending champion is hunting another title. 🥎 #AUSL

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup individual race after Series 2: Kowalik leads. Sami Williams (Series 1 MVP) is in contention. Two series to go. Series 3 starts Aug. 24. No defending champion sitting this one out. 🥎 #AUSL #softball

article.headline: Kowalik Is Back — and She's Leading the 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup After Series 2

stories.title: Texas Longhorns — Back-to-Back WCWS Champions Begin Three-Peat Chase

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text: Texas softball is the back-to-back Women's College World Series champion. Teagan Kavan is the first pitcher in WCWS history to win consecutive Most Outstanding Player awards. She's a senior in 2027. The three-peat conversation has already started. 🥎 #HookEm

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text: Teagan Kavan: 2025 WCWS MOP. 2026 WCWS MOP. Two national titles. First ever back-to-back MOP in WCWS history. Texas swept Texas Tech both years. The Longhorns are the standard right now. 🥎 #softball #HookEm

article.headline: Texas Has Back-to-Back WCWS Titles. Now Teagan Kavan and the Longhorns Are Chasing History.
